description: Empowering Students with Future AI Skills: 5-Day Hands-on Workshop on Generative AI, LLMs, RAG

sessions.topic: Introduced the fundamentals of LLMs, including their evolution, tokenization, embeddings, and basics of prompt engineering.
Explained the Transformer Decoder architecture with focus on embeddings, masked self-attention, and Add & Norm layers for context-aware generation.
Covered decoder internals such as multi-head attention and FFN, along with an introduction to RAG to address LLM knowledge limitations.
Discussed complete RAG pipelines, vector databases, re-ranking, and evaluation methods to improve accuracy and reduce hallucinations.
Hands-on hackathon where participants applied LLM and RAG concepts to build and demonstrate real-world solutions.
